svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Strip: 615 mm of 150 x 1.5 mm plain steel strip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill an 11 mm hole on the centre line 10 mm from one end (the top).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Twist: clamp the top end in a vice and turn the bottom end with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a long spanner on a clamped bar, half a turn per 300 mm: just

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over one full turn in all. Keep the edges straight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rod: 160 mm of 10 mm round bar; file the ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: hold the strip inside the flue foot, push the rod through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one flue hole, the strip's hole and the other flue hole. The

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: strip hangs 10 mm above the throat top with 3 mm clear of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sleeve; it lifts out with the flue.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the twisted strip passes through a 160 mm ring.
